fields.name: mode
fields.description: How this stage is scheduled: `legacy` keeps the hand-rolled path authoritative, `shadow` runs the queue beside it and records what it would have done, `queue` makes the queue authoritative. Rollback is a write back to `legacy`.

fields.name: concurrency
fields.description: How many jobs of this queue may run at once, across every host that shares the store.

fields.name: attempts
fields.description: Total attempts before a job becomes terminal `failed` carrying its named error - this replaces the replay deferral budget.

fields.name: attemptTimeoutMs
fields.description: Wall clock one attempt may take. A handler that exceeds it is interrupted, the attempt is consumed and the job is retried with the usual backoff. It must stay at or below `lockExpirationMs`, and it should sit above the handler's observed p99.

fields.name: backoffBaseMs
fields.description: First retry delay; the schedule grows exponentially from here.

fields.name: backoffCapMs
fields.description: Upper bound on a retry delay.

fields.name: lockRefreshMs
fields.description: How often a running handler renews its claim; a crashed worker stops renewing here.

fields.name: lockExpirationMs
fields.description: When an unrenewed claim expires and the job becomes claimable again by any host. The evaluation plane keeps 15 minutes to match its documented stranded-job grace.

fields.name: retentionDays
fields.description: How long completed and failed job rows are kept for operator readback. Evidence stores are never governed by this value.
